# Simple Ops

Simple Ops is a New Zealand business improvement consultancy for owner led businesses. It starts with the operational problem and commercial outcome, then uses process, technology or AI only where useful.

## Primary pages

* [Home](https://simpleops.co.nz/): What Simple Ops does and who it helps
* [Services](https://simpleops.co.nz/services.html): Current services, prices, timing and fit
* [About](https://simpleops.co.nz/about.html): Founder experience and working approach
* [Why Simple Ops exists](https://simpleops.co.nz/why-simple-ops-exists.html): Experience and practical thinking behind the approach
* [Insights](https://simpleops.co.nz/insights.html): Practical guidance based on operating experience
* [FAQ](https://simpleops.co.nz/faq.html): Access, confidentiality, recommendations and value
* [Contact](https://simpleops.co.nz/contact.html): Enquiry form and contact details
